source.title: Banking Ordinance 1941, consolidated text (Hebrew Wikisource mirror), s.5(א)

regulator.notes: Banks are supervised by the Supervisor of Banks at the Bank of Israel, who holds "הפיקוח הכללי והבקורת על כל תאגיד בנקאי" (Banking Ordinance s.5(א)); the banking corporations themselves are the 17 entries (11 ordinary banks) in the BoI's list on data.gov.il (REG-03, 2026-10-22).

lawful_exit.text: at the maturity the deposit agreement sets, or at an exit point if the product has them (types of one year and over show whether exit points exist and how often); earlier only by breaking the deposit, which needs the bank's consent where it was not agreed in advance and can cost the interest and part of the principal; a deposit of up to six months may renew automatically unless withdrawn (BANK-02, BANK-05, BANK-06, BANK-14, BANK-27)

source.title: Tax Authority, דע זכויותיך וחובותיך 2025, printed p.40 ("סעיפים 21–23 – ריבית ורווחים מפיקדונות ותוכניות חיסכון"): profits accumulated in deposits and savings plans are taxed at withdrawal ("מחויבים במס בעת המשיכה")

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Moving a deposit to another bank means withdrawing it: no law lets a running deposit move on its terms (SW-32); under the account-switching service it stays at the old bank until maturity (SW-29). At maturity or an exit point the interest is paid and the bank withholds 15% or 25% as usual (TXI-07, TXI-08), so the move adds no tax beyond the ordinary maturity. Breaking before maturity needs the bank's consent where it was not agreed in advance and can cost the interest and part of the principal (BANK-06); how the tax treats a broken deposit is open (TXI OQ14). New money can go to another bank through a closed-system account (BANK-21).

eligibility.text: any individual; a bank may not unreasonably refuse a deposit; since 1 December 2025 an individual may also open a shekel deposit at a bank other than their own without a current account there, through a closed-system account fed only from, and returning only to, their own account (not at a small bank, BANK OQ5); minimum amounts and amount tiers are product terms, not law

protection.text: no deposit insurance exists in law; if a bank cannot meet its obligations the Governor may appoint an authorised manager and transfer its assets and liabilities, and may, with Government approval, announce that the Bank of Israel guarantees its deposits, a discretionary power and not an entitlement; a 2026 law orders an examination of deposit insurance within a year; a private bill would guarantee NIS 250,000 per customer at small banks, but it is only a bill; whether a fall in the CPI can reduce the principal of a linked deposit is a product term ("הבטחת קרן"), not a rule
